title.narrative: Business Excellence for Sustainability and Transparency (BEST)

description.narrative: (Mongolia): .In support of the Indo-Pacific Strategy under trade and competitiveness, USAID's BEST program expands and diversifies Mongolia's economy by increasing access to financing for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and improving economic governance and accountability. USAID will work with government and private sector partners to foster an environment conducive to SME growth, including easier access to loans, improved corporate governance, training on transparency and accountability, and the provision of small grants to disadvantaged enterprises..To improve corporate governance, USAID will provide SME with tailored training on good corporate governance, including in strengthening internal controls, minimizing the probability of fraud losses, improving the levels of transparency and disclosure, and facilitating forums on SME good corporate governance practices. To improve local governance, USAID will conduct training courses and workshops on transparency and anti-corruption, accountability, and informed policy decisions for aimag-level (province-level) and soum-level (district level) government officials. USAID, through BEST, also will mentor and train local NGOs on advocacy and capacity-building on how to provide local oversight and monitoring of the government's SME lending mechanism. .... .
